## Spotube V6 is here 🎉🚀

### 🔥Highlights

- Migration from Flutter to Compose Multiplatform, [learn why we did it](https://spotube.cc/blog/compose-multiplatform-migration/)
- UI redesign, introducing [Millennium](https://github.com/team-spotube/millennium/) UI. 2000s look and feel with 2026's modernity
- Jam sessions, play music with friends and family in sync. Runs on a new dedicated room server, with host-only controls and device bans to keep rooms safe
- Full Android Auto integration. Browse, Library, Search all are there now, not just queue
- iOS now plays audio through VLC, so every streaming format works, and keeps playing in the background
- Migration from hetu_script to Kotlin for plugin development. Powered by [Zipline by Cashapp](https://github.com/cashapp/zipline/)
- More extensibility, plugin support for Lyrics provider and Scrobbling providers
- Redesigned plugin manager. Plugin login pages can only reach cookies and scripts of the domains they declare
- Native Android APK, with reduced apk size, performance improvements and more native android integrations.
- Relicensed from BSD-4-Clause to AGPL-3.0-or-later for a more Open Source friendly licensing. And for preventing distribution of closed source and maliciously modified Spotube.
